title: Walsh characters on concatenated blocks
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $a,b,x,y\in\mathbb F_2^n$. Concatenate each pair of vectors to form vectors of length $2n$. The Walsh character indexed by the concatenation of $a$ and $b$, evaluated at the concatenation of $x$ and $y$, equals the product of the Walsh character indexed by $a$ evaluated at $x$ and the Walsh character indexed by $b$ evaluated at $y$.
